ai_result.long_description:
Keep your everyday essentials compact and organized with this handmade brown leather minimalist wallet for men. Made from high-quality vegetable-tanned genuine leather, it is sewn entirely by hand and designed for convenient carry in a jeans pocket or shirt pocket.

The wallet has 2 compartments: one for banknotes and one for up to 5 cards. Measuring 2.75 × 3.93 inches (70 × 100 mm), its practical minimalist design keeps essential cards and cash together without unnecessary bulk. Its handmade construction also makes it a thoughtful gift for a loved one.
